source: Analytical axial continuum in two unit cubes separated by a 10 micrometre void; explicitly idealized displacement-continuity connection across the gap, zero adhesive compliance. This is not a physical adhesive/contact validation.
geometry: [0,1]^3 and [1+g,2+g]x[0,1]^2; g=1e-5 m; independent C3D10 nodes and bodies, unchanged emitted coordinates
loads: Uniform total +x force 1e6 N at x=2+g; consistent quadratic nodal forces
supports: ux=0 at x=0, uy=uz=0 at origin, uz=0 at (0,1,0); free lateral contraction
formulation: Experimental planar mortar generated by projection onto the master plane; equal displacement on opposing traces, all translations. No change to physical mesh coordinates, no native TIE, no weak springs, no adhesive stiffness. Closing coordinates exists only in a temporary integration view, never in the deck or result geometry.
expected: u_x=sigma/E*(x for left, x-g for right); u_y=-nu*sigma*y/E; u_z=-nu*sigma*z/E; sigma=(1e6,0,0,0,0,0); end ux=2e6/210e9. Gap length adds no compliance by this declared idealization.
samples: Every nodal displacement and all raw four-point IP stress components; every slave node, native free-equation count, external support reactions, global-origin moments and native binary FRD double-precision coordinate audit
exclusions: None in this axial patch; no interface stress exclusions. Shear/bending transfer over a physical gap, curved/partial/nonunit interfaces, more than 65 nodes per trace, multiple bonds and scaling are unvalidated. Product assembly solve admission belongs to T020.
reason: Predeclared existing B07 physical tolerances and absolute text-output floors, with a new explicitly gapped kinematic model. Gap approval bound is limited to the measured 10 micrometre unit-square case; it is not a universal CAD tolerance. Existing B07 criteria and rejected native TIE remain unchanged.
